ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels concentrated in the lobe centers to low-intensity black/grey pixels localized at the perimeter and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white geometric regions occupy the central-lower portion of both lobes. Dense black/grey mottling and stippling are localized along the trailing edges and radiate outward from the central median notch. Discrete, small-scale black focal spots are scattered within the white field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees; notch depth penetrates significantly toward the peduncle connection point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits more pronounced, jagged protrusions near the lateral tip compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curvature characterizing the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/yellowish pixel groups (barnacles) are concentrated on the far-left lateral tip and as isolated points within the dark central notch region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the interior white surface of the right lobe, oriented semi-vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive stalked barnacle colonization (protruding from the pixel boundary) on the posterior-lateral margin of the left lobe; visible irregular trailing edge trauma on the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The left fluke tip possesses a unique structural silhouette characterized by a dense, protruding cluster of stalked barnacles that breaks the continuous geometric line of the trailing edge.
